newsitem.title: USA: Bear Stearns expected to issue debt.
newsitem.headline: Bear Stearns expected to issue debt.

text.p: Bear Stearns Cos Inc was expected to tap the corporate bond primary market with a $250 million debt offering on its own behalf, syndicate sources said on Thursday.
The A2/A rated deal was expected to include a five-year maturity, sources said.
Unofficial price talk was seen between 50-52 basis points over U.S. Treasuries, they said.
On July 15, the firm filed a shelf offering with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register up to $5 billion in debt securities and warrants.
The company said proceeds from the sale would be used for corporate purposes, which may include repaying outstanding short-term debt.
